purpose: Single-use confirmation of the Stage-8 public-data fault-model conclusions after the heartbeat development replay selected no candidate.

hypotheses.h1: A homogeneous Bernoulli loss model is inadequate across AADM flights.
hypotheses.h1_test: Monte Carlo Pearson overdispersion test at alpha 0.05, with complete flight as the independent unit.
hypotheses.h2: The exact 10 percent task-loss assumption is not necessarily representative.
hypotheses.h2_test: Report whether 0.10 lies inside the flight-cluster bootstrap 95 percent interval; do not substitute this test for the heterogeneity test.
hypotheses.h3: ALFA does not identify semantic receiver-context reset probability even when FCU boot markers are observable.
hypotheses.h3_test: Audit SYSTEM_TIME boot-time decreases and MAVROS reconnects; preserve the semantic-observability boundary regardless of event count.

execution_rule.reason_no_candidate_replay: The frozen development replay selected NO_CANDIDATE for all alternatives.

claim_boundary: This confirms a public-data fault model, not the spectrum-selection algorithm.
AADM internal frame gaps are lower-bound uplink loss proxies.
ALFA FCU boot evidence is not semantic receiver-process evidence.
No board-level context persistence, process restart, power interruption, or recovery claim is permitted.
No heartbeat candidate is selected or tuned with confirmation values.
